meta.notes: v10_number uses template heading numbers; unnumbered fields use prefixes TP (title page), SYN (synopsis field), FM (front matter), 3.u (unnumbered estimand headings), and letter suffixes (a, b) for unnumbered subheadings under a numbered v10 heading. portion=part rows carry 'part' = which part. Targets with number 'title-page' are unnumbered title-page fields named by title. change_type 'drop' with targets means the bulk is dropped but the listed part lands.
gotchas: Several v11 heading texts embed their own number (eg '9.1.1 Definitions of Adverse Events', '11.2.1 Investigator Responsibilities', '10.4.1 Primary Objective [#]', '12.4 <tab> Liver Safety...'); strip before title matching.
v10 'Study' is 'Trial' in v11 throughout; normalise before comparing titles.
